summary: Quantitative modeller with ~7 years across ALM, balance-sheet, and derivatives analytics, targeting the Vice President, Capital Markets Treasury Quant mandate at RBC. Led design and implementation of an enterprise multi-asset cash-flow projection and liquidity-gap engine in Python; holds delegated sign-off on valuation, sensitivity, and ALM outputs for institutional portfolios of $5-25bn per engagement, independently reviewing curve construction, spread calibration, and rates/FX/inflation derivatives pricing. Model governance committee member; daily user of Claude Code and Cursor for AI-assisted model development. CFA, dual MSc (Financial Modelling; Chemical Engineering).
core_skills: Python (pandas, NumPy, SciPy), SQL, VBA, Git version control

sections.heading: Model Development & Implementation
bullets: Led design and implementation of an enterprise multi-asset cash-flow projection engine supporting base, stress, and reverse-stress scenarios, delivering forward-looking liquidity visibility across ALM and funding horizons.
Architected configurable time-bucketed liquidity gap analytics (T+1 through multi-year), enabling funding optimization, refinancing risk assessment, and asset-allocation decisions.
Re-engineered manual spreadsheet workflows into scalable Python analytics pipelines with embedded logging, validation, and auditability controls.

Built agentic AI development workflows (Claude Code, Cursor IDE) automating code generation, validation scaffolding, and anomaly detection, cutting development cycle time an estimated 30-40% on comparable modules.

sections.heading: Curve, Spread & Derivatives Model Review
bullets: Holds delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and ALM outputs for institutional portfolios of $5-25bn per engagement (~$50bn+ cumulative), independently reviewing curve construction, spread calibration, and cross-asset interactions prior to production release.
Validated derivatives pricing outputs across rates, FX, and inflation, confirming sensitivity consistency at portfolio-level ALM aggregates.
Oversaw interest rate risk and duration analysis under parallel and non-parallel rate shocks, aligned with IRRBB standards analogous to OSFI B-12 and Basel Committee frameworks.
Reviewed aggregation logic converting security-level exposures into portfolio-level risk metrics feeding downstream ALM and capital processes.

sections.heading: Model Documentation, Governance & Business Support
bullets: Serves on the model governance committee, contributing to methodology review, model documentation and benchmarking standards, and ongoing model-performance assessment for client-delivered analytics.
Escalated outputs lacking mathematical or economic defensibility and acted as escalation point for client-critical analytical issues with Heads of Risk and investment stakeholders.

Prepared analytical summaries for senior stakeholders on interest rate exposure, scenario impacts, and balance sheet sensitivities, translating quantitative output into decision-ready narratives for non-technical audiences.

Led onboarding and implementation for U.S. and Canadian pension funds and asset managers migrating to the PFaroe DB (risk & ALM) and PFaroe PM (portfolio management) platforms; validated model outputs post-deployment.
Translated investment-team requirements into scoped development requests for Product Owners and advised clients on asset, liability, and ALM configurations.

roles.title: Senior Consultant - IFRS & Financial Risk Transformation

bullets: Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 transformation projects for Canadian and international insurance clients, aligning regulatory requirements with system implementation and financial-reporting frameworks.
Advised actuarial, finance, IT, and program-management functions on standards adoption and contributed to governance documentation and regulatory-readiness processes.
Built and interpreted stochastic economic scenario generators assessing interest rate risk and funding volatility under base-case and stressed environments.
Performed cash flow, liquidity, and hedging analysis across interest rate, inflation, and currency risk for international institutional clients.
Delivered ALM studies analyzing funding ratios, duration mismatch, and long-term balance sheet risk exposures for pension funds and institutional investors.
Performed asset-only and surplus portfolio optimization on VaR and CVaR using Ortec's GLASS platform, with risk decomposition and near-optimal frontier analysis to test allocation robustness.

education: MSc, Chemical Engineering (Full Scholarship) - Western University, 2016
